Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. The blocks that form our foundational teams — People, Finance, Counsel, Hardware, Information Security, Platform Infrastructure Engineering, and more — provide support and guidance at the corporate level. They work across business groups and around the globe, spanning time zones and disciplines to develop inclusive People policies, forecast finances, give legal counsel, safeguard systems, nurture new initiatives, and more. Every challenge creates possibilities, and we need different perspectives to see them all. Bring yours to Block.

Square hardware is the physical connection between sellers and Square: Readers that turn any phone or tablet into a point of sale, Square Stand, and Android-based devices like Square Register, Terminal, and Kiosk. In this role, you'll own the quality bar for all Square hardware products. You'll decide when a release is ready for our factories and for our sellers, and lead the team that proves it.

You will:

• Own the release quality bar for all Hardware programs. You'll sign off on builds going to the factory (NPI and production) and on OS, firmware, and app releases going to sellers in the field.
• Define and oversee the validation strategy, both manual and automated, across the stack: applications, OS, firmware, and payment hardware. This includes device compatibility across the phones, tablets, and peripherals our sellers use.
• Decide when product software is good enough for sellers. You'll evaluate risk at each phase of development, manufacturing, and deployment, and give clear go/no-go recommendations to product and engineering leaders.
• Lead a team of about 10 contract test engineers and manage vendor partners. You'll set priorities, staffing, and expectations, and hold the team to a high bar.
• Partner with Hardware engineering, product, program management, and manufacturing teams to plan releases, build testability into products, and drive critical issues to resolution.
• Expand test automation on device test racks to lower the manual regression burden over time, and keep questioning what we test manually and why.

Qualifications

You have:

• 8+ years of verification, validation, or software engineering experience, including shipping consumer electronics or embedded devices.
• Experience defining and owning a validation strategy for a complex product, from development through manufacturing and production release.
• Experience leading test teams, including contractors or outsourced vendors.
• Sound judgment on product risk, and a track record of identifying, prioritizing, and driving issues to closure across multiple products and releases.
• Experience as a strong partner to development, product, and operations teams, with clear written and spoken communication.

Even better:

• Experience with NPI, factory test, or manufacturing release processes.
• Experience validating Android/AOSP-based devices, firmware, or payment hardware.
• Experience building test automation where off-the-shelf tools don't exist, including CI and hardware-in-the-loop test racks.
• Experience supporting ongoing releases across multiple hardware products at the same time.

We’re working to build a more inclusive economy where our customers have equal access to opportunity, and we strive to live by these same values in building our workplace. Block is an equal opportunity employer evaluating all employees and job applicants without regard to identity or any legally protected class. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances.

We believe in being fair, and are committed to an inclusive interview experience, including providing reasonable accommodations to disabled applicants throughout the recruitment process. We encourage applicants to share any needed accommodations with their recruiter, who will treat these requests as confidentially as possible. Want to learn more about what we’re doing to build a workplace that is fair and square? Check out our I+D page.

While there is no specific deadline to apply for this role, U.S. roles are typically open for an average of 55 days before being filled by a successful candidate. Please refer to the date listed at the top of this job page for when this role was first posted.

Block takes a market-based approach to pay, and pay may vary depending on your location. U.S. locations are categorized into one of four zones based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

To find a location’s zone designation, please refer to this resource. If a location of interest is not listed, please speak with a recruiter for additional information.

Application Guidelines

Candidates may submit up to 9 active applications within a 60-day period. Reapplications to the same role are accepted 90 days after a previous application has been reviewed.

Use of AI in Our Hiring Process

We may use automated AI tools to evaluate job applications for efficiency and consistency. These tools comply with local regulations, including bias audits, and we handle all personal data in accordance with state and local privacy laws.

Contact us here with hiring practice or data usage questions.
